span.p:
1 · Weighted quality
five dimensions × published weights

div.style: color: rgb(4, 47, 46) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 · Recency decay
exp half-life · reviews 365d, incidents 180d

div.style: color: rgb(4, 47, 46) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 · Bayesian shrinkage
toward the 3.9 population prior

span.p:
7 · Incident penalties
base × severity × decay, deducted after

div.style: color: rgb(4, 47, 46) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Lift, clamp, then deduct — never both at once.
Applying them together let ten commendations
absorb a severe damage incident and the score
never moved.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A hard clamp put every exceptional guest on
exactly 1000.0. Saturation keeps the top of the
scale strictly increasing, so the best guests
stay rankable and good behaviour still pays.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Scoring a record the guest is actively contesting
is the thing a dispute process exists to prevent.
